title: Analytical Procedures (Assay SM2) [Assay][CP-8]
description: Core quality information (2.3.3.AP) for Analytical Procedures (Assay SM2) [Assay][CP-8].

action.title: Column
action.description: Silica C18 3,5 µm 250x4.6 mm or equivalent

action.title: Test solution
action.description: Approximately 1.0 mg/ml of sample to be examined in diluent (acentonitrile:phosphate buffer(1:4))

action.title: Reference solution
action.description: Approximately 1.0 mg/mg of CP-8 standard in diluent.

action.title: Calculation
action.description: The content of CP-8 is calculated according to the following formula: (Am*Cs/As*Cm)*V Am =   Peak area value of CP-8 in the test solution As =   Peak area value of CP-8 in the reference solution Cs =   Weight of CP-8 (mg) in the reference solution Cm =   Weight of CP-8 (mg) in the test solution V =     Assay of CP-8 standard, in % Report the result “as is”.
